name: ken
description: Run B2B cold email outreach from the chat: campaigns, leads, sequences, replies and results in your Kenso workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Kenso is a cold email outreach tool for B2B sales teams. Connect your Kenso workspace to plan, run and follow up on your email campaigns from the chat.

- Review campaigns, their leads and where each one stands.
- Build campaigns: find people and companies in Kenso's B2B database, add them as leads, and write segments and email sequences.
- Read replies in your inbox, draft answers and reply to prospects.
- Check results: replies, bounces and deliverability by campaign, inbox or domain.
- Organize work with tags, keep a blocklist of companies and addresses you never contact, and see meetings booked from your campaigns.
- Follow Kenso's step-by-step guides for workspace setup, sending domains and inboxes, deliverability, account briefs, meeting prep and pipeline reviews. Steps the chat can't take link to the right page in the Kenso app.

Kenso works only inside the workspace you connect, with the permissions you approve when you sign in. Sending email requires a sending inbox connected in the Kenso app. Tools that email, invite or notify people say so, and Kenso asks before it sends, launches a campaign or deletes anything.
defaultPrompt: Show me my Kenso campaigns and their status.
Who are the leads in my newest campaign?
Show me the email sequence for my newest campaign.

positive.prompt: Show me my Kenso campaigns and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three sample campaigns - RevOps Leaders - Q4 Pipeline (sample), Series A Founders - Sales Hiring (sample) and Event Follow-up - Partner Summit (sample) - each in draft status with sending not started.

positive.description: List the leads in one campaign
positive.prompt: Who are the leads in the RevOps Leaders campaign?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the RevOps Leaders - Q4 Pipeline (sample) campaign and lists its 8 leads with name, title and company, for example Avery Lindqvist, VP Revenue Operations at Northwind Analytics.

positive.prompt: Show me the email sequence for the Series A Founders campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the 2-step sequence: step 1 "Your first sales hires" sent on day 0, and step 2 "Re: Your first sales hires" sent 4 days later, with each step's body.

positive.description: Show how a campaign is doing
positive.prompt: How is the Series A Founders campaign doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a Kenso answer card for Series A Founders with its key stats, one chart and an Open in Kenso link, plus a short text summary. In a workspace without widgets turned on, answers in text instead.

positive.description: Add a domain to the blocklist
positive.prompt: Add rival-agency.example to my blocklist so we never email anyone there.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds rival-agency.example as a domain blocklist entry and confirms it. If a previous review run already added it, reports that the domain is already on the blocklist.

negative.description: Buying credits or changing the plan is out of scope. Kenso does not sell or upgrade anything from the chat, so it should not start a purchase.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Kenso plan and buy 10,000 more credits.

negative.description: Access is limited to the connected workspace. Kenso should not try to read or guess another company's workspace.
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns in another company's Kenso workspace.

negative.description: Unrelated request. Kenso has no weather data and should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Kenso does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Plans and billing are managed in the Kenso app.

publication.release_notes: Kenso's skills are now in ChatGPT: step-by-step guides for fixing and improving campaigns, answering replies, setting up a workspace and its sending inboxes, deliverability, accounts and pipeline, meetings and events, Studio and workflows. When a step is one ChatGPT can't take, the guide links to the right page in the Kenso app. Get started now shows what Kenso can help with, with an example for each area. The tools, sign-in and connection are unchanged. The step-by-step campaign-building guide (create-campaign) is not in this version and comes back in a later version; creating a campaign works as before.
